message:
http: reduce delay-close issues for HTTP/1.1 and below (#19863)

skipping delay close for HTTP/1.0 framed by connection close (as it simply reduces time to end-framing) as well as HTTP/1.1 iff the request is fully read (so there's no FIN-RST race)

Addresses the Envoy-specific parts of #19821 

Signed-off-by: Alyssa Wilk <alyssar@chromium.org>
